patterns.description: Poor staff attitude and customer service issues
Long wait times experienced by customers

root_causes.pattern: Poor staff attitude and customer service issues
root_causes.cause: Understaffing, lack of employee training, or poor management oversight leading to stressed service workers.
Inconsistent kitchen preparation, possibly exacerbated during peak hours when staff are rushed.

root_causes.pattern: Long wait times experienced by customers
root_causes.cause: Kitchen and front-of-house bottlenecking during busy periods due to inadequate staffing levels.
